Ngemva kokuba amaphaneli efakwe embhalweni we-Studio, imithetho ye-Studio uqobo yokugcina nokuvumelanisa iyasebenza. Sebenzisa kuphela imibhalo yesandla okungeyakho noma onemvume yokuyisebenzisa.

panelImport.mode.reflow.title: Ukuthola amaphaneli okuzenzakalelayo · ukuhlela kabusha okuqondile
panelImport.mode.reflow.body: Thola imingcele yamaphaneli ekhasini lekhomiki eliskeniwe noma esithombeni eside se-webtoon, uwalungise, uwahlele kabusha abe umugqa oqondile ongu-690/720 px bese uwayifaka njengamaphaneli e-Studio.
panelImport.mode.cards.title: Isiki sezindaba zamakhadi (4:5)
panelImport.mode.cards.body: Sika umbhalo wesandla omude oqondile ube amakhadi amaningana angu-1080×1350 e-Instagram, usika ezikhaleni kude namabhaluni nobuciko, bese ukhipha i-ZIP yama-PNG.
panelImport.workbench.confirmReset: Amaphaneli nezilungiselelo ozishintshile zizolahleka. Ifayela lakho langempela alithintwa. Uqala phansi?
panelImport.source.title: 1. Qinisekisa amalungelo bese ukhetha isithombe
panelImport.source.hint.reflow: Khetha ikhasi elilodwa lekhomiki eliskeniwe noma isithombe eside se-webtoon. Amaphaneli ayatholwa futhi ahlelwe kabusha abe umugqa oqondile.
panelImport.source.hint.cards: Khetha isithombe esisodwa eside esiqondile sombhalo wesandla. Sisikwa sibe amakhadi angu-4:5 (1080×1350). Isithombe esiqondile esikhishwe ku-Studio naso siyasebenza.
panelImport.attest.statement: Lo mbhalo wesandla ungowami noma nginemvume yokuwusebenzisa
panelImport.source.rights.notice: Izkena noma imisebenzi yabanye abantu ingaba ne-copyright. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa kurekhodwa nomphumela; akusona iseluleko sezomthetho noma isitifiketi samalungelo.

panelImport.review.title: 2. Buyekeza futhi ulungise amaphaneli
panelImport.review.hint.select: Hudula iphaneli ukuze uyihambise bese uhudula imiphetho yayo ukuze ushintshe usayizi. Uma iphaneli ligxilile, izihluthulelo zemicibisholo nazo ziyasebenza (Shift = 1 px, Alt = shintsha usayizi).
panelImport.review.hint.draw: Hudula phezu kwesithombe ukuze udwebe iphaneli elisha.
panelImport.review.hint.split: Cindezela ephanelini lapho ulayini wokuhlukanisa kufanele uye khona.

panelImport.reflow.title: 3. Hlela kabusha kube umugqa oqondile
panelImport.reflow.intro: Amaphaneli abekwa ngokulandelana kokufunda njengomugqa owodwa oqondile wobubanzi obulinganayo. Iphaneli ngalinye lidwetshwa kabusha kusuka kokwangempela njengesithombe esisha.
